<message>
I just celebrated my 40th birthday and realized that roughly half of my life is already spent. That though does send shiver down my spine.
</message>
output: I guess what scares me is how fast it went, and how I can't really account for where it all went. I want the second half to mean something more, to not just slip by the same way. Saying it out loud makes it feel real in a way I wasn't ready for.
